ops.title: long-running 1.0.547 drive-pack exec re-measure (2026-11-13 01:20 UTC)
ops.body:
PR #4655 (long-running 1.0.547) rollout and re-measure.

Pickup: capt-hookd's registry fingerprints installed_plugins.json plus each pack's file digests per project root (captain_hook/daemon/registry.py, PLUGIN_TTL 30 s), so every worker loaded the 1.0.547 pack within 30 s of the install, with no session or capt-hookd restart. hooks.json commands stay as each session loaded them until /reload-plugins (drive install's reload_sessions types it into drive sessions) or a restart, but they run installed.py, which runs the newest install's script. The drive MCP server's launch line is version-free, so a running server keeps its old mcp.py until the session restarts. `drive setup` rewrote ~/.local/bin/drive with the direct-exec resolver.

eslogger exec, 5.5 s windows (before: exec-storm/before.jsonl 2026-11-13 00:35 UTC; after: capt-hook-exec-gate/measure/after.jsonl 01:20 UTC):
- Pack interpreter launches: 56 execs (30 mise + 26 python, about 28 script runs, all 1.0.536) became 16 direct python3.13 runner execs, 0 mise.
- Execs rooted in the pack, script children included: 55 became 27.
- Machine total: 1040 became 1320. powermetrics DEAD_TASKS went from 21035 to 30668 ms/s.
- The growth comes from elsewhere: Claude Code `/bin/sh -c` shell-snapshot and `ps -o command= -p` probes (bash 182 to 281, ps 118 to 193), and drive settled.py's `uvx spawnllm decide --provider jev` (7 to 80 execs in the window: 20 decide calls from one python3.14.10 drive process).
